children: Loop Industries has formed a Board-level Strategic Alternatives Committee to prioritize securing capital for its planned India joint venture and to evaluate strategic and financial options to maximize shareholder value.
Board created Strategic Alternatives Committee to advance commercialization and strengthen capital position.
Immediate priority: help secure required capital contribution and project financing for the planned India joint venture.
Committee will evaluate options: project debt, strategic capital, equity, licensing, partnerships, JV, M&A or going-private.
Chairman Jeff Geygan leads the board-led review; CEO Daniel Solomita continues to run operations and JV efforts.
No decision or timetable established; company may not reach a transaction or disclose further details until approved.
